## Promotion Checklist
Before changing ai-mv code, confirm:
- the pattern worked on multiple benchmark cases
- the pattern was not just one lucky seed
- failure modes are documented
- the pattern maps cleanly to still_prompt_text or clip_prompt fields
- repo-side sanitization will not destroy the winning syntax
